qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the M8 screw when installing the water pump to crankcase?
What is the torque specification for the M6 screw when installing the water pump to crankcase?
Which section of the manual covers Water Pump and Drive specifications?
What component is being attached to the crankcase according to the 1AZ specification?
What unit of measurement is used for all torque specifications on this page?
How many different screw sizes are specified for water pump to crankcase installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different screw sizes: M8 and M6

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque values between the M8 and M6 screws for water pump installation?
qa_pairs.answer: 12 Nm (M8 requires 22 Nm while M6 requires 10 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: Which screw size requires higher torque for water pump to crankcase installation?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 screw requires higher torque at 22 Nm
